dataset: BIOME4 4.1 comprehensive driver dataset soil fields
license: GPL-2.0-only as distributed in the official BIOME4 4.1 package

sourceOperationalSemantics.whc: BIOME4 driver passes each layer value directly as layer water-holding capacity; source-code comments call these capacities mm even though inputdata.nc declares mm/m
sourceOperationalSemantics.perc: BIOME4 passes each layer value directly as the daily percolation coefficient k; daily soil-water code evaluates k * wetness^4 without a 24-hour conversion, despite inputdata.nc declaring mm/hr
sourceOperationalSemantics.otherLargeValues: 999.9 WHC and 999 percolation are not special-cased by BIOME4 and are therefore preserved as numeric model inputs

preprocessing: source float32 values preserved without quantization; grid reordered north-to-south and longitude -180..180; one uint8 status map derived from documented BIOME4 WHC flags
